profile_name.description: The name of the profile for this filament. If there is a profile specifically for this filament, that is what should be specified, even if it is printer specific. For slic3r variants, data after the '@' does not need to be included and will be removed when loading into python.

overrides.description: Key-value pairs for settings that should be overridden for this filament

id.description: The slicer-native identifier for this filament profile (e.g. GFB00, FFF02)

generic_id.description: Fallback generic slicer profile ID for this material type (e.g. GFL99 for Generic PLA). Used when no brand-specific profile exists.

prusaslicer.x-description: Settings for PrusaSlicer and derivatives. Profile name references built-in or custom profiles.

bambustudio.x-description: Settings for Bambu Studio. Compatible with Bambu Lab printers and X1/P1 series.

orcaslicer.x-description: Settings for Orca Slicer. Fork of Bambu Studio with extended features.

cura.x-description: Settings for Ultimaker Cura. Uses Cura profile naming conventions.

superslicer.x-description: Settings for SuperSlicer. Fork of PrusaSlicer with additional features.

elegooslicer.x-description: Settings for Elegoo Slicer. Compatible with Elegoo FDM printers.

crealityprint.x-description: Settings for Creality Print. Compatible with Creality FDM printers.

anycubicslicer.x-description: Settings for AnyCubic Slicer. Compatible with AnyCubic FDM printers.

kirimoto.x-description: Settings for Kirimoto. Compatible with Kirimoto FDM printers.

generic.x-description: Generic temperature settings that apply across all slicers without profile references.
generic.description: Generic options that will automatically be mapped to the correct config definition for each slicer. Slicer specific settings are applied first, then these are applied on top.

first_layer_bed_temp.description: The target bed temperature for the first layer in the generated profile. Should ideally be within [min_bed_temperature, max_bed_temperature].

first_layer_nozzle_temp.description: The target nozzle temperature for the first layer in the generated profile. Should ideally be within [min_print_temperature, max_print_temperature].

bed_temp.description: The target bed temperature for the generated profile. Should ideally be within [min_bed_temperature, max_bed_temperature].

nozzle_temp.description: The target nozzle temperature for the generated profile. Should ideally be within [min_print_temperature, max_print_temperature].

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description: Canonical UUID (UUIDv4), assigned automatically by CI on merge. Leave empty when creating.

moved_from.title: Moved From
moved_from.description: Former canonical UUIDv4(s) this entity previously had (before a merge or move). Lets old UUID references resolve here. Managed by tooling/CI — leave empty when creating.

id.title: ID
id.description: The unique identifier for this filament

name.title: Name
name.description: The manufacturer's name for this filament

diameter_tolerance.title: Diameter Tolerance (mm)
diameter_tolerance.description: The diameter tolerance of the filament in mm (e.g., ±0.02)

density.title: Density (g/cm³)
density.description: The density of the filament in g/cm³. Used for weight calculations.

shore_hardness_a.title: Shore Hardness A
shore_hardness_a.description: Hardness on Shore A scale (for flexible materials, typically 20-95)

shore_hardness_d.title: Shore Hardness D
shore_hardness_d.description: Hardness on Shore D scale (for rigid materials, typically 20-90)

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Certifications the material has (e.g., food-safe, medical-grade)

max_dry_temperature.title: Max Dry Temp (°C)
max_dry_temperature.description: Maximum temperature (°C) for drying without degradation

min_print_temperature.title: Min Print Temp (°C)
min_print_temperature.description: Minimum recommended nozzle temperature for printing (°C)

max_print_temperature.title: Max Print Temp (°C)
max_print_temperature.description: Maximum recommended nozzle temperature for printing (°C)

preheat_temperature.title: Preheat Temp (°C)
preheat_temperature.description: Recommended nozzle temperature for preheating/load cell bed leveling (°C)

min_fan_speed.title: Min Fan Speed (%)
min_fan_speed.description: Minimum recommended part cooling fan speed (%)

max_fan_speed.title: Max Fan Speed (%)
max_fan_speed.description: Maximum recommended part cooling fan speed (%)

dry_temperature.title: Dry Temp (°C)
dry_temperature.description: Recommended drying temperature (°C), as opposed to the maximum in max_dry_temperature

dry_time.title: Dry Time (h)
dry_time.description: Recommended drying time at the drying temperature (hours)

enclosure.title: Enclosure
enclosure.description: Whether printing this filament requires an enclosed printer

min_nozzle_diameter.title: Min Nozzle Diameter (mm)
min_nozzle_diameter.description: Minimum nozzle diameter recommended for this material (mm)

data_sheet_url.title: Data Sheet URL
data_sheet_url.description: URL to the manufacturer's technical data sheet

safety_sheet_url.title: Safety Sheet URL
safety_sheet_url.description: URL to the safety data sheet (SDS/MSDS)

discontinued.title: Discontinued
discontinued.description: Mark if this filament has been discontinued by the manufacturer

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Sourced sustainability data (recycled and bio-based content, carbon footprints, relative claims). Every number must be copied verbatim from a cited source.

mechanical.title: Mechanical Properties
mechanical.description: Sourced mechanical properties (tensile, flexural, impact, heat deflection) per print direction, from the brand's data sheet. Every value must be copied verbatim from a cited source.

slicer_settings.title: Slicer Settings
slicer_settings.description: Configure slicer profiles and temperature overrides for different slicing software
